entities.summary: Jean-Luc Chéreau is a French businessman and son of the founder of Chereau trailers www.chereau.com, one of Europe's largest refrigerated trailer unit manufacturers. He is also a former amateur racing driver. providing sponsorship to Larbre Compétition's GT racing activities from 1994-2002 as well as driving.
